items.title: THE BEST HOMEMADE SANDWICH BREAD | HONEY WHEAT BREAD RECIPE
items.why: actual recipe with real measurements, mixing/kneading technique, and a full shaping demonstration you can follow step by step.

items.title: Sourdough vs. “Normal” Bread. What’s the Difference?
items.why: coherent explanation of what technically distinguishes sourdough from yeasted bread, including the fermentation breakdown and how to spot fake sourdough at the store.

items.title: This Is What Makes Sourdough Bread Healthier for You Than Every Other Bread
items.why: AI-narrator filler ('testament to', 'delves into') pads real nuggets like the glycemic-index explanation -- worth jumping to that part only.
items.best_label: glycemic index and blood sugar explanation

items.title: Should You Still Learn to Code?
items.why: one solid historical analogy (mechanical reaper displacing farmers) stretched across a lot of generic 'learn AI or get left behind' framing.

items.title: Learn to code at 30: It's not too late... here's why
items.why: the $200k-debt personal turnaround story is genuinely specific, but it's bookended by generic 'don't quit your day job, take a course' advice.

items.title: coding with 0 experience made me $243 in 2025 - USE this app (not chat gpt)
items.why: rambling, barely-edited screen-share with no clear payoff -- title brags about $243, which tells you how thin the result actually is.

items.title: How The Internet Works | Simple Explanation
items.why: genuinely clear, well-sequenced technical explainer -- IP addresses, packets, and the router-layer analogy all land cleanly.
items.best_label: packets wrapped in router IP layers

items.title: 5 Rules for Learning to Code in 2025 (That Actually Help)
items.why: a 20-year dev gives five distinct, actionable rules with a real recap, not just 'build projects and stay motivated' platitudes.

summary_line: The recipe and explainer videos actually teach you something; most of the 'learn to code in the AI era' pile is the same pep talk wearing a different creator's face.
